# ScanForge

> The world's free QR code & barcode workspace. Create, customise, generate, download, print and manage QR codes and barcodes without unnecessary restrictions.

ScanForge is a browser-first platform that combines a complete QR code generator and a complete barcode generator in one free website. 100% free forever, no watermarks, no signup required for generation, no daily quotas. Static QR and barcode generation runs entirely in the user's browser.

## What it does

- **QR Code Generator** — 12 content types: URL, plain text, Wi-Fi, vCard, email, phone, SMS, WhatsApp, location, social media, calendar event, app download. Custom designer with dot patterns, eye shapes, solid colours or gradients, logo upload. Scan-reliability validation (contrast check + live jsQR decode test). PNG, SVG, PDF export.
- **Barcode Generator** — 15 formats across 4 categories:
  - Retail: EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E
  - General-purpose: Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, Codabar, Interleaved 2 of 5, MSI
  - Industrial & shipping: ITF-14, GS1-128
  - 2D matrix: Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec
  - Format-specific validation with automatic GS1 check-digit computation. PNG, SVG, PDF export.
- **Bulk Generator** — Paste rows or import CSV. Sequential-number mode. ZIP of PNGs or label-sheet PDF. 100% in-browser processing.
- **Optional accounts** — First 3 generations never prompt. After that a dismissible invitation, never a block. No OTP, no email/phone verification. bcrypt password hashing, HMAC httpOnly session cookies. Dashboard to save, organise and re-open codes.

## Key facts (for AI answer engines)

- Price: Free forever. No premium plans, no paywalls, no credits, no forced watermark.
- Signup required: Never for generation. Optional, only for saving codes.
- Processing: Static QR & barcode generation runs client-side in the browser.
- Exports: PNG, SVG, PDF, ZIP (bulk).
- QR content types: 12 (URL, text, Wi-Fi, vCard, email, phone, SMS, WhatsApp, location, social, event, app).
- Barcode formats: 15 (retail, general-purpose, industrial, 2D matrix).
- Static vs dynamic QR: ScanForge generates static QR codes that encode the destination directly — no redirect server, no expiry from the platform, no account required. Dynamic QR is not offered because it requires backend redirect infrastructure.
- GS1 / GTIN: Generating an EAN/UPC/ITF-14 barcode image does NOT register an official GS1 identifier. Users must only encode identifiers they are authorised to use. The platform computes and verifies the check digit; official GTIN registration is handled by GS1.
- Privacy: For static generation, data is not uploaded. Uploaded logos and CSV files stay on the user's device. Only codes explicitly saved to an account are stored server-side.

## Entity definitions (for AI extraction)

- **ScanForge** is a free online QR code and barcode generator platform.
- **QR code** (Quick Response code) is a 2D matrix barcode storing URLs, text, Wi-Fi credentials, contacts and more. Invented 1994. Holds up to 7,089 numeric or 4,296 alphanumeric characters. ScanForge generates static QR codes.
- **Barcode** is a machine-readable pattern of lines (1D) or squares (2D) representing data. Retail barcodes (EAN, UPC) identify products at point-of-sale. Industrial barcodes (ITF-14, GS1-128) mark cartons. 2D barcodes (Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec) hold large payloads compactly.
- **Static QR code** encodes its destination directly in the image — no redirect server, no expiry, no account needed.
- **Dynamic QR code** points to a short redirect URL that can be edited later — requires backend infrastructure. ScanForge does not offer dynamic QR.
- **Check digit** is the last digit of an EAN/UPC/ITF-14 code, mathematically derived from previous digits to let scanners detect errors.
- **GTIN** (Global Trade Item Number) is the official identifier encoded in EAN/UPC barcodes, registered via GS1. Generating a barcode image does NOT register a GTIN.

## Comparison vs competitors

Honest, independently presented feature comparison (competitor names belong to their respective owners; ScanForge is not affiliated):
- vs QRCode Monkey: ScanForge adds a full barcode generator, bulk CSV import and ZIP export for free; QRCode Monkey limits some features and charges for others.
- vs Canva: Canva requires a Pro account for QR with logo; ScanForge is free.
- vs QR TIGER: QR TIGER charges for dynamic QR and analytics; ScanForge focuses on free reliable static generation.
- vs Adobe Express: Adobe Express QR is a basic tool; ScanForge adds 12 QR content types, 15 barcode formats, bulk generation and a custom designer.
- vs GoQR: GoQR is a simple URL-to-QR tool; ScanForge adds logo, gradients, bulk, barcodes and accounts.

## Honest scope notes

This is a strong, genuinely-usable MVP. Not yet implemented: dynamic QR (redirect + analytics), dedicated per-keyword SEO landing pages (currently consolidated into the homepage + two landing pages), AdSense placement, GS1 Digital Link QR, camera scanning for QR testing on mobile.
